_comment: The 8 crew whose original designs were lost (confetti-8). New identities, authored 2026-08-18 under the director's 'all yours' mandate. Outfit base colors deliberately match the stopgap suits already in-game (sage/slate/cream/rust/steel/khaki/amber/olive) so the regeneration reads as the same person coming into focus, not a cast change. bot_lindqvist keeps the white hair the director photographed.

chars.identity: A Scandinavian woman in her late 40s, pale complexion, silver-white hair in a short practical crop, calm weathered face with faint laugh lines
chars.habitat: a sage-green utilitarian botanist's jumpsuit with rolled sleeves, soil-worn knees, an empty chest-rig of small tool loops, muted green accent piping

chars.identity: A tall Senegalese man in his early 30s, deep brown skin, close-cropped black hair, slim build, focused thoughtful expression
chars.habitat: a slate-blue communications coverall with a soft padded fabric collar, thin cable piping along one shoulder seam, slate accent stripes at the cuffs

chars.identity: A stocky French woman in her 50s, olive skin, dark hair in a tight bun streaked with grey, warm no-nonsense face
chars.habitat: a warm cream galley smock with a wraparound half-apron front over grey work trousers, sleeves pushed to the elbow, cream accent trim

chars.identity: A wiry Brazilian man in his 40s, tan skin, short black curls, light stubble, easy confident bearing
chars.habitat: a muted rust-orange driver's jacket with padded elbows and a high collar over a grey coverall, rust accent panels on the shoulders

chars.identity: A broad-shouldered Black woman in her mid 30s, dark skin, shaved head, steady level gaze
